# One-sample t-test power calculation
# H0: μ = 0 vs H1: μ > 0 (one-sided)
# Parameters
n <- 25                    # sample size (participants)
mean_diff <- 0.2          # hypothesized mean increase
sd <- 0.5                 # standard deviation
alpha <- 0.05             # significance level (one-sided)

# Calculate Cohen's d (effect size)
cohens_d <- mean_diff / sd

# Non-centrality parameter for t-distribution
# ncp = (mean_diff / (sd / sqrt(n))) = (mean_diff * sqrt(n)) / sd
ncp <- (mean_diff * sqrt(n)) / sd

# Degrees of freedom
df <- n - 1

# Critical t-value for one-sided test at alpha = 0.05
critical_t <- qt(1 - alpha, df)

# Power is the probability of rejecting H0 when H1 is true
# P(t > critical_t | ncp) under the non-central t-distribution
power <- 1 - pt(critical_t, df, ncp = ncp)

# Summary
cat("One-Sample t-test Power Calculation\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 40), "\n")
cat("Hypothesis: H0: μ = 0 vs H1: μ > 0 (one-sided)\n")
cat("Significance level (α): ", alpha, "\n")
cat("Sample size (n): ", n, " participants\n")
cat("Mean difference: ", mean_diff, " units\n")
cat("Standard deviation (SD): ", sd, " units\n")
cat("Cohen's d: ", round(cohens_d, 4), "\n")
cat("Degrees of freedom: ", df, "\n")
cat("Non-centrality parameter: ", round(ncp, 4), "\n")
cat("Critical t-value: ", round(critical_t, 4), "\n")
cat("Power: ", round(power, 4), "\n")

# Output result in required format
POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "power", value = round(power, 15), unit = "probability")
  ),
  simulation = NULL
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(POWER_AGENT_RESULT, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Monte Carlo simulation verification
set.seed(42)

n <- 25
mean_diff <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
nsim <- 100000

# Simulate data under the alternative hypothesis
# H1: true mean = mean_diff
reject_count <- 0

for (i in 1:nsim) {
  # Generate sample from normal distribution with mean = mean_diff
  sample <- rnorm(n, mean = mean_diff, sd = sd)
  
  # Perform one-sample t-test: H0: μ = 0
  t_stat <- (mean(sample) - 0) / (sd(sample) / sqrt(n))
  
  # One-sided critical value
  crit_t <- qt(1 - alpha, n - 1)
  
  # Reject if t_stat > critical value (upper tail)
  if (t_stat > crit_t) {
    reject_count <- reject_count + 1
  }
}

# Empirical power
empirical_power <- reject_count / nsim

# Standard error
se <- sqrt(empirical_power * (1 - empirical_power) / nsim)

cat("Monte Carlo Simulation Verification\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 50), "\n")
cat("Simulations: ", nsim, "\n")
cat("Seed: 42\n")
cat("Rejections: ", reject_count, "\n")
cat("Empirical power: ", round(empirical_power, 15), "\n")
cat("Standard error: ", round(se, 6), "\n")
cat("95% CI: [", round(empirical_power - 1.96*se, 6), ", ", 
    round(empirical_power + 1.96*se, 6), "]\n\n")

# Compare to theoretical power
df <- n - 1
ncp <- (mean_diff * sqrt(n)) / sd
critical_t <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
theoretical_power <- 1 - pt(critical_t, df, ncp = ncp)

cat("Theoretical power: ", round(theoretical_power, 15), "\n")
cat("Difference: ", round(abs(empirical_power - theoretical_power), 6), "\n")

# Output
POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "power", value = round(theoretical_power, 15), unit = "probability")
  ),
  simulation = list(
    seed = 42,
    trials = nsim,
    failures = 0,
    mcse = round(se, 15),
    confidence_interval = list(
      round(empirical_power - 1.96*se, 15),
      round(empirical_power + 1.96*se, 15)
    )
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(POWER_AGENT_RESULT, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))

# Independent analytical verification
# H0: μ = 0 vs H1: μ > 0 (one-sided, upper-tail test)
# Parameters from request
n <- 25
mean_diff <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05

# Step 1: Effect size (Cohen's d)
d <- mean_diff / sd
cat("Effect size (Cohen's d):", d, "\n")

# Step 2: Non-centrality parameter
# For one-sample t-test: ncp = (μ1 - μ0) / (σ / √n) = d × √n
ncp <- d * sqrt(n)
cat("Non-centrality parameter ncp:", ncp, "\n")

# Step 3: Critical t-value for one-sided test
df <- n - 1
t_crit <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
cat("Critical t-value (df=24, α=0.05 one-sided):", t_crit, "\n")

# Step 4: Power calculation
# Power = P(T > t_crit | H1 true) = 1 - F_nct(t_crit; df, ncp)
power_analytical <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = ncp)
cat("\nAnalytical power (non-central t-distribution):", power_analytical, "\n")

# Verify formula consistency
cat("\n--- Formula Verification ---\n")
cat("t-statistic under H1: t = (ȳ - 0) / (s/√n) ~ t(df=24, ncp=2)\n")
cat("Rejection region: t > ", round(t_crit, 4), "\n")
cat("Power = P(t > ", round(t_crit, 4), " | ncp=", ncp, ") = ", 
    round(power_analytical, 6), "\n")

# Double-check with alternative formulation
# Using the property that if X ~ N(μ, σ²), then Z = (X - 0)/(σ/√n) ~ N(ncp, 1)
# But for small samples, we use the t-distribution with ncp parameter
power_check <- 1 - pt(t_crit, df, ncp = ncp)
cat("\nPower (double-check):", power_check, "\n")

# Output in required format

  results = list(

  )
)

# Evidence e1; success=true

# One-sample t-test power calculation
# H0: μ = 0 vs H1: μ > 0 (one-sided)
# Parameters
n <- 25                    # sample size (participants)
mean_diff <- 0.2          # hypothesized mean increase
sd <- 0.5                 # standard deviation
alpha <- 0.05             # significance level (one-sided)

# Calculate Cohen's d (effect size)
cohens_d <- mean_diff / sd

# Non-centrality parameter for t-distribution
# ncp = (mean_diff / (sd / sqrt(n))) = (mean_diff * sqrt(n)) / sd
ncp <- (mean_diff * sqrt(n)) / sd

# Degrees of freedom
df <- n - 1

# Critical t-value for one-sided test at alpha = 0.05
critical_t <- qt(1 - alpha, df)

# Power is the probability of rejecting H0 when H1 is true
# P(t > critical_t | ncp) under the non-central t-distribution
power <- 1 - pt(critical_t, df, ncp = ncp)

# Summary

# Evidence e3; success=true

# Monte Carlo simulation verification
set.seed(42)

n <- 25
mean_diff <- 0.2
sd <- 0.5
alpha <- 0.05
nsim <- 100000

# Simulate data under the alternative hypothesis
# H1: true mean = mean_diff
reject_count <- 0

for (i in 1:nsim) {
  # Generate sample from normal distribution with mean = mean_diff
  sample <- rnorm(n, mean = mean_diff, sd = sd)
  
  # Perform one-sample t-test: H0: μ = 0
  t_stat <- (mean(sample) - 0) / (sd(sample) / sqrt(n))
  
  # One-sided critical value
  crit_t <- qt(1 - alpha, n - 1)
  
  # Reject if t_stat > critical value (upper tail)
  if (t_stat > crit_t) {
    reject_count <- reject_count + 1
  }
}

# Empirical power
empirical_power <- reject_count / nsim

# Standard error
se <- sqrt(empirical_power * (1 - empirical_power) / nsim)

cat("Monte Carlo Simulation Verification\n")
cat("=" , rep("=", 50), "\n")
cat("Simulations: ", nsim, "\n")
cat("Seed: 42\n")
cat("Rejections: ", reject_count, "\n")
cat("Empirical power: ", round(empirical_power, 15), "\n")
cat("Standard error: ", round(se, 6), "\n")
cat("95% CI: [", round(empirical_power - 1.96*se, 6), ", ", 
    round(empirical_power + 1.96*se, 6), "]\n\n")

# Compare to theoretical power
df <- n - 1
ncp <- (mean_diff * sqrt(n)) / sd
critical_t <- qt(1 - alpha, df)
theoretical_power <- 1 - pt(critical_t, df, ncp = ncp)

cat("Theoretical power: ", round(theoretical_power, 15), "\n")
cat("Difference: ", round(abs(empirical_power - theoretical_power), 6), "\n")

# Output
POWER_AGENT_RESULT <- list(
  results = list(
    list(metric = "power", value = round(theoretical_power, 15), unit = "probability")
  ),
  simulation = list(
    seed = 42,
    trials = nsim,
    failures = 0,
    mcse = round(se, 15),
    confidence_interval = list(
      round(empirical_power - 1.96*se, 15),
      round(empirical_power + 1.96*se, 15)
    )
  )
)

cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=", jsonlite::toJSON(POWER_AGENT_RESULT, auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15))
